courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋
related.transfer: 可遷移「形狀尋找：膜面為何不能任意畫」與「安裝後的膜張力量測與驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Form finding: why a membrane cannot take any shape" and "Post-installation membrane tension measurement and acceptance" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Millennium Dome roof must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦由預應力平衡求膜面形狀，經雙軸試驗、裁片補償、展開吊升與分階段張拉，把膜屋蓋做成不積水、不鬆弛的曲面；倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋則以以 12 支約 100 m 桅桿、約 70 km 鋼索與 PTFE 玻纖膜構成的輕量索網屋蓋，及其風吸力、索夾與膜片維護為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on finding membrane shapes from prestress equilibrium, then biaxial testing, compensated patterns, hoisting and staged tensioning to build roofs that neither pond nor go slack; Millennium Dome roof centres on A lightweight cable-net roof of 12 masts about 100 m high, about 70 km of steel cable and PTFE-glass fabric: wind uplift, clamps and panel upkeep, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「邊索垂度與膜預應力」與「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「風洞試驗與雷諾數效應」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Edge-cable sag and membrane prestress” and “Radial net and 12 masts”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Millennium Dome roof, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wind-tunnel testing and Reynolds-number effects", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 張拉膜屋蓋成形
history.titleEn: Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs
history.text: 現代張拉膜結構的形狀尋找由 Frei Otto 推動：他在 1964 年於斯圖加特大學創立輕量結構研究所，以肥皂膜與實體模型研究極小曲面，並與 Rolf Gutbrod 設計 1967 年蒙特婁世博會德國館。1970 年代的慕尼黑奧運屋蓋促成迭代電腦計算，1974 年發表的力密度法與後來的動態鬆弛法讓形狀尋找與裁片計算成為標準流程。1981 年啟用的吉達哈吉航廈以 210 個 PTFE 玻纖錐形單元覆蓋大面積候機空間，1994 年完成的丹佛國際機場 Jeppesen 航廈則以雙層 PTFE 膜與鋼索構成約 34,800 m² 的主屋頂。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件或施工許可。
history.textEn: Form finding for modern tensile membranes was driven by Frei Otto, who founded the Institute for Lightweight Structures at the University of Stuttgart in 1964, studied minimal surfaces with soap films and physical models, and designed the German Pavilion at Expo 67 in Montreal with Rolf Gutbrod. The Munich Olympic roof of the early 1970s prompted iterative computer methods, and the force density method published in 1974, followed by dynamic relaxation, made form finding and patterning standard procedure. The Hajj Terminal in Jeddah, opened in 1981, covered a vast waiting area with 210 PTFE-glass conical units, and Denver International Airport's Jeppesen Terminal, completed in 1994, used double-layer PTFE and steel cables for a main roof of about 34,800 m². This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents or construction authorisation.
